entities.name: Şebnem Korur Fincancı
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Şebnem Korur Fincancı is a Turkish medic, former professor, and former president of the Turkish Medical Association (TBB). She is a member of the Turkish Human Rights Association (TİHV). In Turkish popular culture she is being called to be the "Turkish female villain".
